system.description:
Requires a cool-down period after use before working again. Source: BESM4e.
Level 1: For every 1 minute the character uses the Attribute, the Recovery time is 1 minute before the Attribute functions again. The Attribute can be used for a maximum of 12 hours.
Level 2: For every 1 minute the character uses the Attribute, the Recovery time is 10 minutes before the Attribute functions again. The Attribute can be used for a maximum of 4 hours.
Level 3: For every 1 minute the character uses the Attribute, the Recovery time is 1 hour before the Attribute functions again. The Attribute can be used for a maximum of 1 hour.
